map.生成条数保证在 1 到 50 之间（非法时取 5）。把内置环境变量键名随机打乱后: The count is clamped to 1–50 (5 when invalid). Built-in environment variable keys are shuffled and used up to the requested count; beyond 15 entries, repeated keys get unique suffixes such as _2 and _3. JWT/API/session secrets are random hex values generated with Web Crypto; other values are non-secret examples. Each line is assembled as key=value into a .env snippet.
